levels.name: First Drop
levels.hint: 🦪 Hit each oyster twice to free it. 🦀 Land a pearl in Shelly's shell to get it back!

levels.name: Zap!
levels.hint: ⚡ Hit an eel and it zaps everything near it.

levels.name: Rock Garden
levels.hint: 🪨 Rocks are solid and never pop.

levels.name: First Jelly
levels.hint: 🪼 Jellyfish drift to and fro. They're springy and never pop.

levels.name: Turning Wheel
levels.hint: 🎡 Coral wheels turn. Time your drop!

levels.name: Sliding Rows
levels.hint: ↔️ Some rows slide back and forth.

levels.name: Whirlpool Hop
levels.hint: 🌀 Whirlpools come in pairs: drop into one and pop out of its twin.

levels.name: Puffer Patch
levels.hint: 🐡 Puffers swell on the first hit and burst on the second, popping everything around them!

levels.name: Bubble Elevator
levels.hint: 🫧 Bubble lifts push your pearl back up for more bounces.

levels.name: Treasure Trove
levels.hint: 💰 Hit a treasure chest and that whole shot scores double.

levels.name: Puffer Chain
levels.hint: 🐡 One burst sets off the next: line them up!

levels.name: The Vault
levels.hint: 🔐 The vault's door is a whirlpool. Or bust it open with a puffer.

levels.name: Moonrise
levels.hint: 👻 Ghost pieces fade in and out. Your pearl only hits them while they're solid.

levels.name: The Lure
levels.hint: 🎣 An anglerfish's glowing lure pulls your pearl towards it. Use it to curve your shots!

levels.name: Starfish Springs
levels.hint: ⭐ Starfish never pop, and they fling your pearl off fast!

levels.name: Golden Find
levels.hint: 🟡 A golden oyster takes three hits, and its pearl comes back to you.

levels.name: Riptide
levels.hint: 🌊 Currents push your pearl sideways as it falls through.

levels.name: Clam Cove
levels.hint: 🐚 Giant clams open and shut. Hit the oyster inside while its clam is open!
